name: The Gap Moe Mob Boss Wants to Win the Cute Barista's Heart!
source:
Aster is a notorious mob boss that had just gotten out of jail. Her first stop: Chronicles of Coffee, a quaint bookshop and cafe. There resides the barista and Aster's true love, Solana. But Solana doesn't know she's Aster's true love. Aster is determined to confess. On the outside, Aster is an intimidating gangster. On the inside, she's a lovesick puppy. Will she be able to convey her feelings and win Solana's heart?

[From [url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/gap-moe-mob-boss]itch.io[/url]]
